name: Notion
jobs: databases with views, relations and rollups
verdict_reason: The docs half moves in an evening and the math is per-seat — but Notion's databases and mobile apps don't move at all. Worth it if you write more than you rollup.
what_you_lose: Databases: views, relations, rollups — Outline has none of it, and that's half of many workspaces
Native mobile apps (Outline's mobile web is fine, not great)
Notion AI and the template ecosystem
Sign-in needs an auth provider you run or configure (magic-link SMTP or OIDC)

what_broke: maildev crashes where IPv6 is disabled; compose ships mailpit instead (unchanged from initial verification)
Outline without SMTP is a locked door: boots healthy but magic-link sign-in silently fails until SMTP_* is configured (unchanged)
Bot re-verification 2026-09-14: all 4 services healthy in 52 s (cold pull). Full workflow not re-timed by bot. Outline v1.10.1 now current.

notes: At one seat the time cost eats the saving; at 3+ seats (Plus is per-seat) the math flips fast. The database gap is the real decision, not the money.
